rules: Component APIs are SSR-safe and may not access browser globals during module initialization or server render.
The shared UI workbench renders every component across theme, direction, density, viewport and remote-data state matrices.
Application code cannot import the underlying headless component vendor directly.
No generic components, utils, helpers, services, stores or common dumping folders are permitted.
Feature folders own routes, view models, query definitions, interactions and tests; cross-feature imports use public package seams.
Responsive behavior is a deliberate transformation, not horizontal scaling of desktop screens.
Data grids provide accessible sorting, filtering, pagination/virtualization, density and card transformation on narrow screens.
Forms provide server/client error association, summary focus, dirty guards, save progress and conflict recovery.
Charts have table alternatives, text summaries and non-color-only encoding.
F0.1 core bootstrap files are exact reservations owned by foundation; src/lib/index.ts is the library seam and src/routes is the SSR workbench, not a business application.

F0.2 core-only packages/api-client and packages/api-mocks are independently versioned generated transport and test packages. UI exports may import neither. tools owns deterministic generation and contract validation. Only exact catalog-reserved paths are permitted.

F0.3 core-only packages/design-tokens and packages/i18n are independently versioned workspaces. src/components and src/workbench contain named catalogued families. UI package public artifacts exclude workbench/routes/server/API code.

scoped_directory_exceptions.condition: Only named component families with exact paths reserved in repository-file-catalog.json; application repositories retain the generic components-directory ban.
